What's Changed

## New Features

- Added a hardened Corosync QNetd container built directly from the official upstream source.
- Added automatic first-start NSS certificate and QNetd CA initialization with persistent storage.
- Added local-development and production Docker Compose templates.
- Added tag-driven GHCR image publishing and GitHub Release automation.
- Added scheduled monitoring for new Corosync QDevice releases.

## Optimizations

- Runs QNetd as an unprivileged user with all Linux capabilities dropped.
- Uses a read-only root filesystem with dedicated temporary runtime mounts.
- Uses a multi-stage build so compiler dependencies are excluded from the runtime image.
- Includes health checks, source-commit metadata, CI validation, and runtime smoke testing.

## Bug Fixes

- Handles the upstream QNetd version command's non-zero informational exit status correctly in CI.
